$comment: Completion bar for #136: reframe Manage plugins as user-facing Add-ons. Renames the page/menu entry to 'Add-ons' with plain-language copy and a 'For plugin authors' link; adds a pre-install preview + consent flow (plugins:preview / installFromPath) that lists what a pack adds and calls out cloud provider domains; bundles example packs (package.json extraResources + plugins:listBundled) as one-click 'Available add-ons'; moves built-in panels out of the page; adds a Removed section with restore (plugins:listRemoved / restore); collapses Install folder/.zip into one 'Install add-on…' button. Moves built-ins out of Manage-plugins; they remain in the TopBar Plugins menu.

criteria.target: grep -q "plugins:preview" electron/main.ts && grep -q "plugins:listRemoved" electron/main.ts && grep -q "plugins:listBundled" electron/main.ts && grep -q "export function restorePlugin" electron/plugin-loader.ts && grep -q "Add-ons" src/plugins/manage/ManagePluginsView.tsx && grep -q "examples/plugins" package.json
